s: Version-controlled repository tracking ML model artifacts, metadata, lineage, and deployment status across environments.
w: Stores model binaries (ONNX, pickle, SavedModel) with version metadata: training data version, hyperparameters, evaluation metrics, and approval status. Models transition through stages: Development -> Staging -> Production -> Archived. Integration with CI/CD triggers automated testing and deployment. Model comparison dashboards track performance drift over versions.
use: Governed model promotion from experiments to production
Audit trail of which model version is serving which traffic
A/B testing infrastructure: deploy two versions, compare metrics, promote winner
Rollback capability when a new model degrades in production
avoid: Teams with single models that never change (YAML config suffices)
Deep learning research environments without production deployment needs

props.registry_backend: MLflow | Weights & Biases | Vertex AI Model Registry

pits: Model artifacts too large for registry storage - store in object store, registry holds pointers and metadata
Missing model lineage tracking makes debugging production failures impossible
tips: Model registry is the ML equivalent of artifact repository + deployment pipeline combined
Stages (Dev/Staging/Production) mirror software release processes - familiar concept for interviewers
